Data Description
You are a risk analyst working in a financial organisation that offers credit cards to customers. Analyze the customer case who has defaulted using the given data. 
The data showcases the aggregated variable data (like mean, max etc) for each month before the customer defaulted on his business credit card. Sharing description wrt all data headers and their risk thresholds -
1. last_cycle_cut_revolve_rate: last cycle cut revolve rate. Values below 0.46 are risky
2. times_30_dpd: No. of times 30 days past due. Values above 1 are risky.
3. cust_expsr_avg_rem_12m_ratio: Customer Exposure / (Average Remit In 2-12 Months). Values above 3.15 are risky.
4. cust_lndexpsr_minloc_6m_ratio: customer lending exposure minloc 6 months ratio
5. max_agec_agel_dyldage: Customer daily Age
6. cb_ten_to_amex_tenure: Credit bureau tenure to company tenure
7. tpf_internal_delinq_idx: Internal Delinquency Index. Values above 5.8 are considered risky.
8. tpf_cust_mod_tenure: Customer Tenure
9. ratio_30_90dys_trig_amt: ratio of 30-90 days trigger amount. Values above 0 are considered risky.
10. avutil_exrvlv_balgt50: Average utilization in all the external consumer revolving trades with balance more than US$ 50. Values above 75 are risky.
11. calx_ratio_daily_max_age: Ratio of Daily delinquency age by Max delinquency age in last 6 months
12. hcam_src_trnd_indx: FICO Trend Index. Values below -19 are risky.
13. lvrg_debt_remit: leverage commercial debt
14. sum_tot_rsky_evnt: total risky events
15. delnqncy_ind_intrnl: internal delinquency indicator. Values above 0.5 are risky.
16. cust_debt_pymcpty_tm_inc: debt to payment capacity
17. cbr_score: customer credit bureau score (FICO)
18. credit_loss_prob: This is a machine learning model (built by the company) score which predicts the likelihood of default by the customer on their existing exposure in the next 18 months. Main purpose is to prevent exposure ramp-up of risky customers to a level where they are no longer able to pay back. Scores from 10-100 are considered risky.
19. tot_struct_risk_score: This is a machine learning model (built by the company) score which predicts the likelihood of default by the customer on internal/ external trades in the next 18 months. The idea is to assess risk of a customer from an overall perspective so the company can make more effective decisions regarding increase/ decrease of card limit etc. Scores from 20-100 are considered risky.
20. avg_remit_minus_max: average remit
21. positive_events: positive events
22. tpf_cust_hi_rvlv_line_am: The amount of a customer's highest revolving lines of trade as reported by the Credit Bureau. Values below 77 are risky.
23. oop_interaction: Out of Pattern Spend index wrt to Exposure. Values above 28.00 are risky.
24. sum_o30dn_o60dn_o90dn: No of triggers greater than 30 days with amount > $500. Values on or above 1 are risky
25. ons_30_trd: ons 30 trades
26. tot_cons_comm_trds_g75: Total External Consumer and commercial trades utilized more than 75%. Values above 1 are risky.
27. hcam_bal_trnd_indx: hcam balance trend index. Values above 2.65 are risky.
28. product_risk_attribute: product risk attribute
29. cust_ext_delinq_idx: External Delinquency Index. Values above 5 are risky.
30. tm_wt_q_score: Time Weighted United Q Score (only for low tenure)
31. cust_eff_se_cdss_5_180_day_score: Merchant Risk Score. Values above 2 are risky.
32. cust_expr_to_arb_inc_ratio: Total exposure to arbitrated income ratio. Values above 0.08 are risky.
33. cust_lend_acct_paydown: customer level paydown on the lending account based on most recent cycle cut date. Values below 0.1 are risky.
34. cust_experian_trans_union_inq_idx: the risk based index of inquiries from credit bureau experian and transunion received in last 730 days. Values above 4.65 are considered risky.
35. cust_intr_extnl_unscr_tt_debt_srvc_rt1: Customer total debt servicing ratio (comprising of both Internal/ External Unsecured trades). Values above 0.15 are considered risky.
36. cust_open_acct_paydown: customer level paydown on the open account based on most recent cycle cut date. Values below 0.3 are risky.
37. cust_old_rec_age: time since the oldest recorded event for the card member
38. cust_atp_arb_incom_am: Arbitrated income
39. exp_pif: pay in full exposure
40. cust_cash_tot_liab_yr1_rt: ratio of cash to total liability corresponding to latest full year financial
41. cust_pymt_chan_risk_score: Customer payment channel risk score. Values above 0.05 are considered risky.
42. cust_lexis_nexis_tot_tax_assess_val_am: the total tax assessed value of the input business address from lexis nexis
43. cust_enhnc_one_way_spend_concentration_30day_rt1: one way spend concentration risk rate of a customer at merchants in last 30 days. Values above 2.4 are considered risky.
44. time_wtd_return_index: Internal Payment Return Index (No Good Cheque History). Values above 0.2 are considered risky.
45. cust_rnn_score: Timeseries Spend Variable. Values above 0.028 are considered risky.
46. cust_min_due_12mo_avg: average number of only minimum due paid in last 12 months. Values above 0.08 are considered risky.
47. gam_clr_erly_risk_score: clear early risk score is the score given by clarity bureau for its customer. Values below 785 are risky.
48. gam_mtge_loan_actl_pymt_am: Mortgage Loan (Actual Payment Amount)
49. se_no_norm_wtd_pd_unpaid_amt: normalised accum amount weighted by merchant percentage of denied/ pended charges. Values above 0 are risky.
50. cust_net_pymt_unbl1: this variable indicates the net remit done by a customer in the unbilled period
51. cust_lexis_nexis_blended_score: the score merges business and owner credit data to predict small business risk. Values below 693 are risky.
52. cust_sbfe_score: Business credit score that is used to predict a business's likelihood of financial delinquency or failure. Values below 863 are risky.
53. cust_dnb_paydex_score: Paydex score is a business credit score that measures a company’s payment performance. Values below 61 are risky.
